title: Almgren wins on marathon debut, Chepkirui regains title in New York
claims: The TCS New York City Marathon was held on Sunday 1 November 2026 and is a World Athletics Platinum Label road race.
The 2026 edition celebrated the 50th anniversary of the race's route through the city's five boroughs.
Andreas Almgren won the men's race in 2:06:01 on his marathon debut, with Yemaneberhan Crippa second in 2:06:14 and Kamohelo Mofolo third in 2:06:26.
Sheila Chepkirui won the women's race in 2:24:36, with Jessica McClain second in 2:24:42 and Hellen Obiri third in 2:24:43.
The men's lead pack passed 10km in 30:52 and halfway in 1:04:01.
The men's leader covered mile 23 in 4:38, and a move was attempted just after the 25km mark on the Queensboro Bridge.
Hellen Obiri's course record of 2:19:51 was not under threat in the still, sunny autumnal conditions.
The race is described as being over 26.2 miles.
